name: tabiji.ai Travel API
description: Free AI-curated travel data — destinations, picks, itineraries, comparisons for 6905+ destinations. No API key required. Covers restaurant guides, day-by-day itineraries, head-to-head destination comparisons, and unified search across all content types.

skills.name: Find Restaurants & Places
skills.description: Find the best restaurants, cafes, bars, or attractions in any city. Returns curated picks with editorial summaries, Google ratings, opening hours, Reddit quotes, 'what to order' tips, and insider tips. Covers 1,616 curated with 15,227+ places across 6,905+ destinations.
examples: Find the best ramen in Tokyo
Where should I eat in Mexico City tonight?

skills.name: Plan a Trip
skills.description: Get detailed day-by-day travel itineraries with activities, neighborhoods, logistics, and timing. Covers 415 itineraries across 6,905+ destinations worldwide.
examples: I need a honeymoon itinerary for Bali

skills.name: Compare Destinations
skills.description: Compare two destinations head-to-head across food, culture, cost, transport, seasonality, and fit. Includes Reddit quotes, data-backed category breakdowns, and a final verdict. Covers 1,218 destination comparisons.

skills.name: Discover Destinations
skills.description: Browse and filter 6,905 travel destinations by region, budget ($–$$$$), season, vibes (City, Beach, Nature, Cultural, Nightlife, etc.), and travel style (solo, family, photography, etc.). Each destination includes a pitch, editorial summary, related picks, itineraries, and comparisons.
examples: Warm places for a March trip
